Name: Sam's Amplified Guitar
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
Upgrade your old guitar to the next level!

I loved playing Hi-Fi Rush, and I wanted a cool electric guitar in Stardew too, so I made this mod.

How to upgrade guitar:
[spoiler]
Unlock the Galaxy Sword.
Buy the Amplifier gadget from Maru and the old guitar from Sam.
Hold the Amplifier and right-click on Sam's Old Guitar to upgrade it.
[/spoiler]
